subject: Split-billing proposal: residency + HSM seat options for Mercy Regional
messages:
From: Susan Park <susan.park@mercyregional.org>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, procurement@mercyregional.org
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Pricing Q: residency + HSM seat packaging

Hi Laura —

Thanks for the demo last week. Procurement asked me to get a concrete pricing/layout for the compliance add-ons we discussed so we can route budget. High level asks:

- Audit logs: we need pricing for both 3-year and 7-year retention tiers (per GB / per month + ingestion).
- HSM/KMS: we will need 2 dedicated HSM seats for US (prod) and 1 HSM seat for a pilot in EU region — give seat vs pooled pricing and any setup/onboarding fees.
- Data residency: Mercy has three business units (Acute, Clinics, Homecare) that will be billed separately. We want a split-billing model where each unit sees its own invoices but share a single residency deployment. Is that possible?
- Pilot credits: we are hoping for a pilot concession (onboarding fee waiver or credit) to get the clinics unit through procurement.

Can you send a short pricing packet + an SOW draft we can share with Finance? Also, what are typical lead times for HSM seats in EU?

Appreciate a quick turnaround — our internal approval meeting is next Wednesday.

Best,
Susan Park
Director, Procurement
Mercy Regional Health

[Attachment: MRH_initial_requirements.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)]

From: laura.bennett@redwood.com
To: Susan Park <susan.park@mercyregional.org>
Cc: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com, procurement@mercyregional.org
Date: Tue, 12 Jan 2027 10:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing Q: residency + HSM seat packaging

Susan — thanks for the clear brief. Per below is a concise proposal and I attached a detailed workbook and a draft SOW for your review.

High-level pricing (initial offer):
- Audit logs:
  - 3-year retention: $0.018/GB/month (ingest billed at $0.007/GB)
  - 7-year retention: $0.030/GB/month (ingest $0.007/GB)
- HSM seats:
  - US dedicated seat (prod): $3,200/seat/month
  - EU pilot seat (on-demand): $3,900/seat/month
  - Pooled pricing (if you commit 3+ seats globally): $2,750/seat/month
- One-time onboarding / residency setup: $12,500 (can be amortized over invoices or credited for pilots)

Split-billing approach: yes — we support a single residency deployment with per-org invoicing. We can map three billing codes so each Mercy unit receives its own invoice and usage breakdown while sharing the same physical deployment.

Pilot concession options (pick one):
1) Waive onboarding fee for Clinics unit and apply a 10% pilot discount to the first 3 months of HSM seats.
2) Apply onboarding fee but amortize it over 6 months and add a $5k credit against the first invoice.

Lead times: US HSM seats typically 2–3 weeks; EU pilot 4–6 weeks (hardware procurement + regional compliance checks).

Attachments included: audit-log-pricing.xlsx, hsm-seat-schedule.csv, MRH_SOW_draft.pdf

Next steps: tell me which pilot concession you prefer and whether you want pooled seats or dedicated for each unit. I can then produce a single-page commercial term sheet for procurement/PO.

Thanks —
Laura Bennett
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0182

[Attachment stubs: audit-log-pricing.xlsx, hsm-seat-schedule.csv, MRH_SOW_draft.pdf]

From: rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
To: Susan Park <susan.park@mercyregional.org>, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@mercyregional.org
Date: Wed, 13 Jan 2027 09:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing Q: residency + HSM seat packaging

Susan / Laura — quick follow from my side on commercial flexibility. We can do more on credits if Mercy is willing to take a 24-month committed spend for the residency and HSM seats across the three units. Proposal I recommend to shorten procurement friction:

- 24-month commitment across all compliance add-ons = 12% contract-level discount (applied to HSM seats and audit-retention pricing).
- Waive onboarding fee for Clinics unit (pilot) + apply 15% pilot HSM discount first 2 months (to make trial painless).
- For split-billing, onboarding fee can be amortized across first invoice cycle by unit or allocated 50/25/25 (Acute/Clinics/Homecare) — we’re flexible, tell us which codes you prefer.

If Mercy wants to avoid a long-term commitment we can still do a smaller concession: a $7,500 onboarding credit + 8% discount on seat pricing for first 6 months.

Happy to jump on a 20-min call tomorrow to finalize.

—Rishi
Head of Sales, Redwood Inference
rishi.malhotra@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0133

From: Susan Park <susan.park@mercyregional.org>
To: laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@mercyregional.org, Tom Liao <tom.liao@hospitalsecure.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 08:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing Q: residency + HSM seat packaging

Thanks Laura and Rishi — that layout helps. A few clarifying items from procurement: 

1) Our accounting requires onboarding fees be capitalized across the business unit paying it. We prefer amortization across 12 months, split by budget code.  
2) For the 24-month commitment, we need assurance on termination rights and migration assistance (i.e., escrow for keys or a controlled export path). Can you add a short clause to the SOW?
3) EU pilot: because Clinics is in the EU, we need confirmation that the EU HSM seat will be independent (no cross-region KV replication unless explicitly enabled).

If you can update the SOW with the amortization language and a short termination/migration paragraph, we can route to Finance. Also — can you send the PO terms (Net 45 is our standard) and a redlined term sheet if needed?

We are leaning toward Option 1 (waive onboarding for Clinics) if you can accept the 24-month commit discount. Otherwise, Option 2 with the $7.5k credit would still be considered.

Regards,
Susan Park
Director, Procurement
Mercy Regional Health

[Note: Tom from our security team is looped for the EU HSM behavior confirmation]

From: marissa_cole@redwood.com
To: Susan Park <susan.park@mercyregional.org>, laura.bennett@redwood.com, rishi.malhotra@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Pricing Q: residency + HSM seat packaging

Susan — thanks, we can accommodate the requests. Quick summary of agreed commercial points to put into the SOW and term sheet: 

- 24-month commitment across the residency + HSM seats -> 12% discount applied to HSM and audit storage rates.
- Clinics unit pilot: onboard fee waived; 15% pilot HSM discount first 2 months.
- Onboarding fee amortization: any setup fees will be amortized over 12 months and invoiced against each unit per their budget codes (we will accept the accounting split you provide).
- Termination / migration assistance: we will add a migration assistance clause (export of keys and a controlled handover playbook). For keys stored in Redwood-managed HSMs, we will include an escrow + export plan; for customer-managed HSMs we will document steps.
- EU HSM seat will be logically isolated by default; KV replication across regions is opt-in and requires explicit authorization from Mercy security.

I uploaded the updated SOW and a one-page commercial term sheet and created a DocuSign envelope for signature. Please review the documents and I’ll route to our legal for any redlines.

DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/example/DS-XYZ123
Attachments in this email: MRH_SOW_draft.pdf (updated), audit-log-pricing.xlsx (updated)

If this looks good I can prepare the final PO-ready packet (including Net 45 payment terms and the amortization schedule) today.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Contracts | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199

[Attachment stubs: MRH_SOW_draft.pdf, audit-log-pricing.xlsx]
